board: board-nRF52840: XIAO nRF52840 direct SMD carrier, 30 x 42 mm
purchasing_notes: Per-carrier assembly quantities; select only standard XIAO nRF52840 SKU 102010448 with unsoldered headers. All 16 module contacts are soldered directly. Module-specific underside battery pattern. External battery is optional. Carrier J1 polarity is pin 1 GND / pin 2 VBAT. Stock, prices, and availability have not been checked. Mounting holes are PCB features, not purchased parts. H1-H6 and TP1/TP2 are unpurchased PCB features, excluded from purchasing BOM and placement files.

parts.assembly: Direct SMD reflow; 14 edge contacts + underside BAT+/19 and GND/20
parts.notes: Fit ONE standard Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840, SKU 102010448, with unsoldered headers. Directly solder all 14 castellated edge lands plus the two underside battery contacts: BAT+ pin 19, battery GND pin 20. This carrier is specific to the nRF52840 underside geometry. Use the matching firmware build. Sense, Plus and other XIAO variants require a separate footprint/assembly review before substitution. Keep carrier components outside module outline, unintended copper insulated, and both battery lands registered to the vendor geometry. Confirm delivered module revision, underside planarity, reflow process, and hidden battery-joint quality on prototypes. Module internal divider supplies firmware battery measurement. Pin 14 VBUS has no carrier connection. Supplier stock and pricing have not been checked.

Bare Bosch BMA400 LGA-12, 2 x 2 mm; align pin 1. Tie SDO to GND for I2C address 0x14 and CSB to 3V3; INT1 to XIAO D2, SDA to D4, SCL to D5. VDD and VDDIO use the module always-available 3V3 rail. LCSC purchasing example retained; authorization/franchise status and inventory are not claimed.

Horizontal/right-angle JST PH, 2.00 mm pitch, two positions; opening faces bottom carrier edge. Preserve original carrier polarity: pin 1 GND negative, pin 2 VBAT positive. This differs from many prewired LiPo plugs, including the example Adafruit pack; use a correctly repinned plug or reversing adapter. Verify polarity before connection. DigiKey displays shortened MPN S2B-PH-K-S; LF/SN suffix is JST finish designation.

Top-actuated SPST-NO momentary factory-reset switch, no locating boss or separate ground terminal; 3.0 x 2.5 mm body, 1.6 mm actuator height, nominal 1.5 N force. Carrier terminal 1 -> FACTORY_RESET / XIAO D0 (P0.02); terminal 2 -> GND. Firmware uses the internal GPIO pull-up and low-power sensing; no external resistor/capacitor is fitted. Hold 5 seconds for Matter/Thread state erasure and reboot with the same provisioned Matter credentials. Manufacturer datasheet A162-E1-07 page 2 recommended land dimensions were checked against local footprint adapted from KiCad 10.0.6: two nominal 0.8 x 1.7 mm lands at +/-1.7 mm (4.2 mm outer span / 2.6 mm inner gap). 10 uA at 1 V minimum applicable load (reference), 5 ms maximum bounce, 100 Mohm minimum insulation resistance. Supplier listing was verified; stock and pricing are not claimed. Do not wash after soldering (manufacturer restriction).
10 kohm, 1%, 0.1 W, 0603 (1608 metric); I2C SDA/SCL pullups to 3V3. No inventory or price claim.
100nF, 50V, X7R, 10%, 0603 (1608 metric); C1 VDDIO bypass and C2 VDD bypass.

parts.value: Protected 1S LiPo, 500mAh, 3.7V nominal, 4.2V maximum; plug polarity reversal required
parts.assembly: External assembly; plug polarity reversal required
parts.notes: External battery example, optional for USB-only assembly. Protected rechargeable 1S 500 mAh pack, 3.7 V nominal / 4.2 V full; manufacturer permits up to 1C (500 mA) charging, sufficient for selected nRF52840 module nominal 50/100 mA charger. Stock plug polarity is opposite carrier J1. Use a polarity-reversing adapter or correctly repinned connector: negative to J1 pin 1, positive to pin 2. Carrier supplies no additional reverse-polarity or cell-protection circuit. Keep battery and its connector leads away from antenna.
PCB holes, not purchased components; enclosure-specific M2 hardware is not included.
